process_behavior.meaning: The council vote is the formal process by which the Ellsworth Falls Village Council decides on an ordinance. It requires a quorum of three members physically present, and adoption requires at least three affirmative votes from the full five-member council. The vote occurs at the regular session on 8 September 2026 as per the agenda, unless the sponsor moves postponement.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The vote takes place at the regular session on 8 September 2026 at 7:00 PM at the village hall.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: The vote occurs once at the 8 September 2026 regular session.
